name: companion
description: Lets the Miyagi tutor engine read and drive VS Code exactly (open, highlight, terminal, apply) over a localhost-only HTTP API.

miyagi.port.description: First localhost port to try. Each VS Code window takes the next free one (8791-8799).

miyagi.engineUrl.description: Miyagi engine; editor/save/terminal events are posted to <engineUrl>/vscode/event.
